content:
Just weeks after announcing a price hike for Apple Music, Apple today announced another price increase for its Apple TV service. The company confirmed to 9to5Mac that the Apple TV monthly fee will rise from US$12.99 to US$14.99.

The Apple One individual plan monthly fee has also been adjusted upward.

Apple TV, Apple One Price Hike

Below are the complete details of this price increase:

  • Apple TV (monthly): US$14.99 (original price US$12.99)
  • Apple TV (annual): US$119 (original price US$99)
  • Apple One Individual Plan: US$21.95 (original price US$19.95)

The prices of other Apple One plans remain unchanged. When Apple raised the Apple Music price last month, it also raised the prices of the Apple One Family plan and Apple One Premier plan, but did not adjust the price of the Individual plan.

The new rates take effect immediately for new subscribers. Apple said existing subscribers will receive a price increase notification approximately one month before the new rates take effect.

The last time Apple raised the Apple TV price was in August 2025, when the monthly fee was increased from US$12.99 to US$9.99. At that time, Apple did not adjust the annual plan or Apple One bundle prices.

Over the past year, Apple has significantly expanded Apple TV's content lineup. Last October, Apple announced a deal to become the exclusive Formula 1 broadcast partner in the United States. The F1 streaming service is included in the standard Apple TV subscription fee at no additional charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added Major League Soccer (MLS) streaming service to Apple TV at no additional charge. Previously, users had to subscribe to the separate MLS Season Pass to watch MLS matches.

Apple has also had several hit new shows in recent months, including the fourth season of Ted Lasso. Apple TV today premiered the second season of Dark Matter. The sixth season of Slow Horses will also debut on September 16.

What do you think of the new Apple TV rates? Considering the content Apple TV offers, is US$14.99 reasonable? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
